From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: CloudBridge marketplace: next steps + schedule technical deep dive

Hi Liam / Emily 

Thanks again for the call today  really appreciated the overview of CloudBridge's marketplace workflow and the potential integration points with your procurement flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You'd like a marketplace listing that supports private offers + single-sign onboarding for your GSI customers. Key success criteria: predictable latency for prompt-heavy flows, granular access controls, and audit logs for procurement.
- Our ask: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with our Partner Solutions Engineer and your marketplace/GSI technical lead to map API authentication, deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated), and SSO/KMS requirements.
- Proposed attendees: you, Emily (marketplace PM), your GSI technical lead (if available), plus Mateo (partner lead) and Neha (solutions engineer) from our side.

Availability (PST)  please pick one: 
- Wed 11/04, 10:0011:00 AM
- Wed 11/04, 2:003:00 PM
- Thu 11/05, 9:0010:00 AM

I've attached our partner one-pager and a short onboarding overview that might help your procurement team. If those look good I can send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read.

Thanks  looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Two quick asks before the call: 
1) Can you include an agenda with 10115 minutes for architecture/requirements, 30 minutes for integration mapping, and 10115 minutes for next-step action items?
2) Could you share any sample auth flows or API call examples we can review ahead of time?

If you send a calendar invite with the agenda and the two attachments included, we'll confirm on our side.

Thanks,
